reviews.title: Needs a beginner introduction video
reviews.text: I paid for this hoping that for $30/year it would be high quality, but no. I am sure there is a way to figure out how to get started on this app, but I’m spending all of my time trying to figure it out. The whole point was to save time. There needs to be a video on how to get started!! Everyone isn’t as tech savvy as the developers, once they have your money you can’t get it back if it doesn’t work for you.

reviews.text: I used to really like this app, but over the past year or so it’s gone from being a simple app that did just what I want to adding social features I had no use for, and then AI features that at first you could ignore, but now are forced in your face. The only reason I haven’t deleted this is because there’s no way to export your data as far as I can tell.

reviews.title: Was good, now awful
reviews.text:
Was great until it started glitching a few weeks ago and now all outfits, collections, and tags are all deleted. Hours of hard work gone. This is after paying premium. I will not be spending money on this app in the future if they are not reliable. Then they demand more money for credits on top of the monthly cost. Who are they kidding.

To respond to the developer who suggested resynching in the app, this has been tried and did not fix. You have way bigger problems.

Second update. Now they deleted everything for me even though I didn’t change a single thing other than sync, so I guess they deleted my stuff as punishment for the bad review? Avoid this app.

reviews.title: not free
reviews.text: Good afternoon, evening, morning to all you guys who decided to read my review, I don’t mean to particularly come off as a cheapskate but there is no reason for a ONLINE AI STYLIST to be paid. Another thing to consider is false advertising (I could be wrong) as when i opened the app it says something along the ways of “continue for free”. I’m sure people would download this to map-out an outfit with ai, but there is not reason for AI ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TO BE PAID especially for a ai stylist.

reviews.title: Never worked
reviews.text: I attempted on several occasions to get the AI to recommend outfit ideas with my photo uploaded. Every single time it came back with an error message that “something went wrong”. It could not tell me what went wrong or if there was anything I had done to cause the problem that I could correct. Quite simply….it doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Forces you to pay subscription
reviews.text: While they say there is a free plan, there is literally no way to get to it. When you sign up, there’s a page that says ‘ free trial’ with a next button. There is no exit. There is no “no thank you” option. They lie, and defraud people by saying there is a free option when there is not

reviews.title: Do not like it
reviews.text: I don’t like it because we are just trying to get outfit ideas and you are making us pay like we just want outfit ideas.

reviews.title: Trial Required
reviews.text: Within about 5 minutes of using the app, it’d made me go through filling out information, and at the end of filling out information it asked me if I’d wanted to start a free trial to use the app. Unfortunately, there is 0 option for me to decline. I’d tried restarting the app to get rid of it, but it just deleted the rest of what I’d filled out and it made me repeat the process, just to have the un-skippable trial forced on me again.

reviews.title: AI Fail
reviews.text: I was so disappointed. After I had gone to the trouble of photographing and uploading most of my clothes, the AI could not figure out how to mix and match materials. It would layer a sweater under a thick sweater with a jean jacket over it. If I listened to this app, I wouldn’t look like a refugee, fleeing home and not stylish and put together.

reviews.title: No outfit ideas
reviews.text: Downloaded this just for the option to get daily outfit inspiration like it claimed to give and never could find that option even with a premium trial.

reviews.title: Pay wall app. Avoid.
reviews.text: What a waist of time. No you cannot try on clothes through ai. You get one free use of it. The rest is a terrible ‘mannequin’ that literally looks like stickers you put on the top. Not even your face on it! Why on earth anyone likes this app unless you’re happy to throw money on it immediately! Or all the happy reviews are fake. Plus where is your tutorial? Common a basic introduction is the bare minimum. Make it clean your app is a giant pay wall app before people download.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I was enjoying this app and all of its features until recently, I’ve experienced a lot of glitches. When I add clothes, sometimes it adds duplicates and when I go to make an outfit and I choose the garment it remains blank. It often creates duplicates that aren’t usable and sometimes uploaded photos turn white and I’m not sure which garment it was. It just remains wide and even after restarting your phone and closing the app it says if the garment was deleted and there’s a white placeholder. They definitely have some updates to make.

reviews.title: No customer support
reviews.text: The AI doesn’t work, and no one will ever reply your customer support messages. Don’t download and don’t waste your money.
